object.Title: The Nativity with the Adoration of the Shepherds
object.Description:
This painting is after an engraving by Martin Schongauer of the same subject.

For the latest information about this object, The Nativity with the Adoration of the Shepherds, visit the Online Collection of the Walters Art Museum.
object.Provenance: William T. / Henry Walters Collection, Baltimore [date and mode of acquisition unknown]; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
object.MuseumLocation: To learn whether this object is now on view, and in which gallery, visit https://purl.thewalters.org/art/37.775
